provenance.procedure: GET /tv/12345/season/1 with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 /tv/{id}/season/{n} contract (ADR-0026). Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb season-1.
provenance.note: Synthesised: a two-episode first season in episode order. The client reads season_number, episode_number, name, air_date and id, mapping each to a FeedItem keyed S01E01, S01E02 with its air date and season/episode attributes.
